query: Desktop autodetects only the Nvidia GPU on a mixed Nvidia+AMD system - one PyTorch build (CUDA vs ROCm) can't see both vendors.

desired.outcome: anr2me (C0): CUDA and ROCm torch can't coexist; need a separate venv with ROCm torch for the AMD GPU. Kosinkadink (maintainer, C1): the 'Advanced' section of the install window lets you pick the environment/backend version.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause class; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct for this workflow.
